content.subject: Quick thought on ShipBob’s recent funding
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,
ShipBob raised $200 million, valuing the company over $1 billion. Such funding often expands reconciliation workloads across teams, creating hidden manual effort, error risk, and increasing the chance of mismatched records.
We build a platform that automatically matches, validates, and posts intercompany transactions, eliminating manual spreadsheets and standardizing audit trails completely.
Would a 15-minute call next week work for you?
Zamp
